_source: Swing-Score rules 12.10.2026 (features/015-coach/swing-score-regeln.md) on top of the concept of 08.10.2026. All numbers are start values – REVIEW(golf), Chris calibrates them with the 50–70 rated amateur swings.

criteria.review: REVIEW(golf): concept T = 5° (placeholder, no public reference values); measurement floor 3° until Chris/Ben have measured.
REVIEW(golf): target 3 : 1 from SHOT_TYPES (tour measurements ~21/7 to 27/9 frames), T = 0.3 (green 2.7–3.3). Floor = target × (1000/fps) / downswing_ms (one frame of uncertainty).

REVIEW(golf): concept chest turn ≥ 85° (tour ~98°), T = 10°. shoulder_turn is a 2D image value (real 90° ≈ 64° in the image per Ben) – the target must be recalibrated to the measuring method of metrics.ts.
REVIEW(golf): pelvis sway at the top, concept 0 cm, T = 4 cm ≈ 8 % torso.
REVIEW(golf): hold the forward bend from address to impact, concept change 0°, T = 5°.
REVIEW(golf): pelvis open at impact, concept 35° (negative = open per score rules 12.10.), T = 10°. 2D proxy – check sign/scale against metrics.ts.
REVIEW(golf): forward bend at address, concept 30° (tour ~30°), T = 5°.

REVIEW(golf): side bend away from the target at address, concept 15°, T = 5°. types.ts defines side_bend as tilt AWAY from the target, so +15 is correct; the synthetic generator uses the opposite sign (see decisions).
